transcript.text: Could you make me a looping video wallpaper for my phone with soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly against a dark background? I’ve been wanting to freshen up my phone because I look at it so often throughout the day. I mean an 8-second video in vertical 9:16, with a slow flowing motion rather than anything abrupt. Please generate it from scratch, not from a photo, and leave the top third mostly dark with most of the ribbons below it so the clock stays readable. I worry a little about wallpapers making my screen feel cluttered. There should be no words, clock graphic, or sound, since my phone supplies the clock, and the repeat should be seamless with no jump when it loops.

Your looping ribbon wallpaper is ready: 8 seconds, vertical 9:16, silent, with no words or clock.

Download it here (the link works for 24 hours):
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbi0m03004dii01m0s226oa/output.mp4?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T022751Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

How I made it:
- No photo was used. I first had the AI create one starting picture of the scene: soft blue and purple glowing ribbons on a near-black background, with the top third left dark for your clock.
- Then I animated that picture slowly and set the video to begin and end on that same frame. That is how the loop repeats with no jump.
- It cost 197 credits in total (5 for the picture, 192 for the video). It is 480p, which is the most the free plan allows.

I couldn't watch the video myself before sending it. Please check two things on your phone: that the top stays dark enough, and that the loop point looks smooth. If either one is off, tell me and I'll make another version, for example with even fewer ribbons up high.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: a rendered 8-second looping wallpaper video with a download link. It lists what was made and what it cost, and it adds caveats (the link expires in 24 hours, and the assistant could not watch the video). That matches "delivered, even with caveats."
